subject: Request: weekend POC — additional sandbox fuel for throughput sweep
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@acme.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC weekend — short notice ask for extra sandbox fuel

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the support so far. We have ramped the Acme predictive inference POC to a larger test bed and want to run a 48h throughput sweep this weekend to validate tail latencies at peak concurrency (target: sustained 3k reqs/min, 8k token avg). The soak will simulate our peak traffic shape and will exercise KV caching behavior.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a one-time promotional fuel top-up for our trial so we can execute the run without interruptions? Specifically we need approximately 150k token credits and the option for two dedicated GPU slots for the test window (we can move off it immediately afterwards).

I attached the run plan (sandbox-plan.xlsx) and a checklist (poc-run-checklist.pdf). If you need a signed MSA/temporary addendum we can fast-track it via DocuSign. We’re trying to finalize logistics by Friday EOD.

Appreciate any quick help — this test is a gating factor for our production readiness decision.

Best,
Julia Park
Head of Models
Acme AI Labs
julia@acme.ai
+1 415-555-0122

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC weekend — short notice ask for extra sandbox fuel

Hi Julia — thanks for the plan and the heads-up.

A few quick clarifying questions so we can move this through approvals:
- Do you need the token top-up to be usable across hosted API only, or do you require Redwood Dedicated slots (private pool) for guaranteed latency?
- Confirm start/end window (you mention 48h this weekend — exact UTC timestamps would help).
- Any compliance or audit logs we should enable for the run (e.g., full request tracing)? That might affect cost and retention.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in. This is an existing trial account (Acme) and they’re asking for a one-time promotional grant plus two dedicated slots for a 48h throughput validation. Proposed ask: 150k token credit + 2 dedicated GPUs for weekend (preemptible after run). They are a high-propensity expansion candidate.

Julia — if you confirm the two items above I’ll put this through for sign-off and confirm timing.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

If both green, I will notify the customer and create a HubSpot task with run start/end timestamps and a support-on-call rotation.

Thanks — Sergio
